problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate a set of delicate electronic components into identical shockproof shipping crates. The components are as follows:
* Component Alpha: fragility rating 60 units
* Component Beta: fragility rating 63 units
* Component Gamma: fragility rating 58 units
* Component Delta: fragility rating 65 units
* Component Epsilon: fragility rating 60 units
* Component Zeta: fragility rating 67 units
* Component Eta: fragility rating 41 units
* Component Theta: fragility rating 67 units
* Component Iota: fragility rating 31 units
* Component Kappa: fragility rating 68 units
* Component Lambda: fragility rating 52 units
* Component Mu: fragility rating 43 units
* Component Nu: fragility rating 49 units
* Component Xi: fragility rating 57 units
* Component Omicron: fragility rating 34 units
* Component Pi: fragility rating 44 units
* Component Rho: fragility rating 36 units
* Component Sigma: fragility rating 40 units
* Component Tau: fragility rating 68 units
* Component Upsilon: fragility rating 59 units
* Component Phi: fragility rating 70 units
* Component Chi: fragility rating 38 units
* Component Psi: fragility rating 61 units
* Component Omega: fragility rating 50 units
* Component Aster: fragility rating 58 units
* Component Obelus: fragility rating 39 units
* Component Bracket: fragility rating 61 units
* Component Slash: fragility rating 46 units
* Component Brace: fragility rating 61 units

Each crate can safely absorb a maximum combined fragility impact of 100 units. The coordinator must place every component into exactly one crate, and the aggregate fragility rating within any single crate must not surpass its capacity. The objective is to utilize the minimal possible number of crates to secure all components for transit.
